question: Should CodexBar accept DeepInfra as a supported core API-token provider after the suspended-balance display defect is repaired?
rationale: The patch adds a new provider rather than repairing an established contract; existing integration work and proof show it is viable, but they do not by themselves establish the permanent core-support boundary.

options.title: Sponsor the core provider
options.body: Keep the DeepInfra provider in core after the focused suspended-balance repair and normal final review.

options.title: Decline core support
options.body: Close the provider addition if the project prefers not to expand its maintained provider catalog for this service.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the core provider
recommendation.body: Keep the DeepInfra provider in core after the focused suspended-balance repair and normal final review.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent branch integration commits make steipete the most relevant available owner for the core-provider scope decision.
